plan.title: Reconcile the starting state and report it
verification: Read `git ls-remote --heads origin` and `git rev-parse HEAD` a second time and compare them with the heads in the report.
Check the list of files read against the startup read list of LOCAL-START-HERE.md.

plan.title: Preserve the local changes and bring the main checkout up to date
verification: Compare the digests of the inventory before and after the update.
Run `git status --short --branch` and confirm that main is neither ahead of nor behind its tracking ref.

plan.title: Create the branch, the worktree and its environment
verification: Run `git worktree list` and `git -C ../OntoKin-worktrees/c272 rev-parse HEAD` and compare the result with the recorded head.
Run `.venv/bin/python tools/doctor_local.py --json` in the worktree and compare the readiness of each profile with the record.

plan.title: Create the task record on the scope's branch
verification: Run `.venv/bin/python tools/chat_workflow.py check` in the worktree.
Compare the SHA-256 of the committed TRD file with the digest in this plan's source record.
Search the task's plan for the readback contracts, their preparation and gate MR, and confirm that none appears.

plan.title: Correct the current-status text if it is still needed
verification: Run the documentation verifier and the workflow check on the commit that carries the correction.
Compare the SHA-256 of `docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/OWNER-DECISION-20261128.md` and of C271's task records before and after the commit.

plan.title: Publish the declaration checkpoint
verification: Compare the output of `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/c272-edit-rebuild-qualification` with `git rev-parse HEAD` in the worktree.
Read the issue and the pull request back with the GitHub CLI and compare their fields with the task record.
Confirm with `git ls-remote --heads origin` that main still has the head observed in TASK-001.

plan.title: Map every required property to its observation and comparison
verification: Check every key of `semantic_state` and of the observation schema in the C255 checker against the rows of the map.
Check each interface named in the map against the function it names in the observer's source and against the limits in that observer's contract.

plan.title: Run the existing observer regression on this host
verification: Run each group a second time and compare exit status and method counts with the record.
Confirm that `git status --porcelain` is empty in the worktree after the runs.

plan.title: Reconcile the C269 audit with C270 and C271
verification: Compare each cited finding with the text of the C269 audit and with the recorded results of C270 and C271.
Check each stated dependency against the coverage map of TASK-007.

plan.title: Record the missing components, their boundaries and effort
verification: Check that every row of the coverage map marked as missing appears in the record with a boundary and an estimate.
Check that every planned new file is named with the requirement it serves.

plan.title: Verify the frozen inputs and start each case in a fresh store
verification: Run the focused tests of the runner, including one that alters one input byte and expects the run to stop.
Compare the recorded program revisions with the historical revisions that the corpus records for `start_065` and `target_075`.

plan.title: Apply the V1 and V2 edits and observe the accepted source
verification: Run the focused tests for both directions.

Compare the SHA-256 of the accepted entry with `443328e2a2e3f2e68245fa1e725b518187aa446ecd7ee3de4675e006cf4e666a` for V1 and `73c95c6509363e492084d7b6959356fe1955f4e78086a72b507167a271a33123` for V2, as the corpus records them.

plan.title: Submit the N1 candidate and observe rejection and preservation
verification: Run the focused test of N1 and compare the retained diagnostic with the response that the C210 proof records for the same candidate.
Compare the SHA-256 of the artifact retrieved after the rejection with the baseline's.

plan.title: Create the accepted-state record and bind the delivered artifacts
verification: Run the focused tests of the record.
Give the record of each case to the authority check of the C255 checker and confirm that it is accepted for its own case and refused when one byte of a retained file is altered.

plan.title: Record every exchange and exercise failure and retry
verification: Run one case with an injected failure, for example a store location that cannot be written, and confirm that its record is kept.
Compare the retained responses of the retry cases with the behavior that the driver of the C210 proof checks for the same requests.

plan.title: Observe geometry, motion and declared relationships from the actual bytes
verification: Run the focused tests of the observation module.
Measure the two historical endpoints of the C210 proof through the same path and compare the result with what the C256 evidence records for them.

plan.title: Implement the missing observations within the recorded boundary
verification: Run the focused tests of each new reader, including its fault control and the test of its imports.
Check the list of implemented and incomplete properties against the gap record and the owner's recorded answer.

plan.title: Score each case and write the per-property results
verification: Run the focused tests of the scoring step, including one in which a field of the observation is replaced by a wrong value and the case must fail.
Compute three poses of the selected blade by hand from the equations of the scoring specification and compare them with the table.
Confirm with `git diff` against the branch's starting revision that the files of C253 and C255 are unchanged.

plan.title: Rebuild each valid case in an empty workspace
verification: Run the rebuild twice in two new directories and compare both results with the delivered bytes.
Inspect the recorded import locations of the rebuild and confirm that none lies inside a checkout.

plan.title: Add the residual controls that the workflow depends on
verification: Run each new control, then remove its fault from the input while keeping the expectation and confirm that the outcome changes.
Compare the SHA-256 of the existing observer and control files with their values at the branch's starting revision.

plan.title: Run the deliberate-fault and positive controls through the workflow's own checks
verification: Remove the fault from one control of each kind and confirm that the workflow then accepts the input.
Check the table against the list in the scoring specification's section on required oracle controls.

plan.title: Assemble the one documented command
verification: Run the command once into a new directory and compare the files it wrote with the usage instructions.
Run it against an output directory that is not empty and confirm that it refuses to write.

plan.title: Run the fresh replay
verification: Compare the structured results of the two runs field by field.
Compare the SHA-256 of each GLB of the replay with the delivered one.

plan.title: Prepare the visual-verification profile
verification: Run `.venv/bin/python tools/doctor_local.py --profile visual-verification --node PATH_OF_NODE_22` in the worktree and compare it with the retained report.
Run `git status --short` in the worktree and confirm that no committed lock, pin or npm file changed.

plan.title: Validate the regenerated GLBs
verification: Compare the validator and Three.js versions in the reports with `tools/package.json`.
Run the check on a directory that holds a deliberately truncated copy of one GLB and confirm that it is refused.

plan.title: Inspect the playback and record the observation
verification: Compare the SHA-256 of the file that the viewer loaded with the delivered GLB's.
Check that the captured frames are of the times that the observation names.

plan.title: Run the checks that the changed scope requires
verification: Compare the revision in every check record with the candidate's commit.
Confirm that the output directories lie outside every checkout and that `git status --porcelain` is empty in the worktree afterwards.

plan.title: Compare failing checks with main on the same host
verification: Compare the test IDs and reasons of the branch's failures with main's record one by one.
Confirm with `git diff --stat` against main that no changed file belongs to a test that fails on main.

plan.title: Publish the deliverable evidence on the scope's branch
verification: Compare the committed files with the manifest and with the run output from which they were taken, by SHA-256.
Search the committed records for the home-directory prefix and the account name and confirm that neither occurs.
Run the documentation verifier on the commit.

plan.title: Write the report with the readiness table
verification: Check each stated requirement state against the evidence it points to.
Search the report for the claims that REQ-029 and REQ-031 exclude.
Run the documentation verifier on the commit that carries the report.

plan.title: Audit every requirement and every changed file
verification: Run `git diff --stat` and `git diff --name-only` against the main head observed at that time and compare the list with the requirement trace.
Compare the SHA-256 of each preserved path of this plan on the branch and on main.
Run the workflow check on the commit that carries the audit.

plan.title: Obtain the independent review of the exact candidate
verification: Compare the commit named in the review record with the head of the branch.
Check each mandatory finding against its resolution and the record of its second review.

plan.title: Integrate under the lease and verify the resulting main
verification: Compare the merge commit read with `git ls-remote --heads origin` with the recorded one, and its tree with the reviewed candidate's tree.
Compare the outcomes of the resulting-main checks with the candidate's and with main's baseline.

plan.title: Resolve the branch and the worktree
verification: Read the remote heads and confirm the recorded state of the scope's branch.
Run `git worktree list` and confirm the recorded state of the worktree.

plan.title: Close the scope on the local closing state
verification: Run the workflow check and the documentation verifier on the closing commit.
Compare the states in `task.json` with the audit of TASK-031 and with the integration record.
Read the remote heads once more and compare them with the recorded push state.

next_action: Implement G3 under option A (owner's answer of 2026-11-28), then scoring (TASK-018), residual and fault controls (TASK-020, TASK-021) and the one command (TASK-022).
